fact: 工作室里有一个约十二英尺高的半球形金属环装置（像测地穹顶但无三角纹），环上装了许多朝内的摄像机，地中央用银色胶带贴了个 X；墙边一排黑色服务器，屋里极热。
quote: It’s a half sphere, about twelve feet high (maybe more, it nearly touches the ceiling), made of metal rings or tracks. ... On the floor in the center of the sphere is an X marked with silver duct tape.
anchor: There’s a strange contraption in one corner of the room

fact: Beck 掀开垃圾袋露出一颗发条头颅：不是她做的，她雇了个研究生做，但结果不满意；头颅有摄像机镜头当眼睛、铰链下颌、喉部麦克风、舌根处小喇叭，整体很 steampunk。
quote: “No,” Beck replies, grimacing. “I hired a grad student to make it, but I’m not too excited about the result.” ... The overall effect is very steampunk.
anchor: I walk around it and stop when I find the face

fact: 头颅自报姓名 Isadora Hardwick，声音是清亮的小女孩嗓音；Clare 与她对话，她说自己最喜欢的书是《Where the Wild Things Are》、最喜欢 Max，“I am a wild thing”。
quote: “My name is Isadora Hardwick.” ... “Max is my favorite. Max is a wild thing. I am a wild thing.”
anchor: There is a quiet whirring, then the jaw shuts

fact: Beck 说明造的不是儿童 AI，而是在测试图灵的 Child Machine 理论，让 Isadora 像真女孩一样“长大”；目标是通过图灵测试“and then some”、能共情、能理解美。
quote: “The end goal isn’t a child AI, but I decided to give her a childhood; I’m testing Alan Turing’s Child Machine theory. ... I want her to be empathetic. And I’m trying to make an AI that can understand beauty.”
anchor: “You’re making a child robot?” I’m puzzled

fact: Beck 说美不是精英主义的，“To find something beautiful is to begin to love”；两人对视、Clare 脸红别开眼。Beck 又说 Isadora 将是她虚拟博物馆的策展人，那座“Museum of Lost Souls”是她的栖息地。
quote: “True beauty is not elitist. I want Isadora to be able to love. ... To find something beautiful is to begin to love.” Beck turns her head and finds me staring at her; we lock eyes for a moment, and I look away, blushing.

fact: Beck 带 Clare 进 VR：先到 Detroit Institute of Arts 中庭看 Diego Rivera 的 Detroit Industry Murals（“I always begin here”），再到卢浮宫侧厅看维米尔《The Concert》（Clare 记得它是加德纳博物馆失窃的那幅），一路还经过 V&A、加尔各答 Marble Palace、新奥尔良教堂、银行保险库，最后到 Art Institute 的 Ando Gallery——两人初遇之地。
quote: I put it in a little side gallery in the Louvre. I like to rearrange things. ... We are in the Ando Gallery at the Art Institute, where I first met Beck.
anchor: “Wait, wasn’t this the one that was stolen from the Gardner Museum?”

fact: 那个 Ando Gallery 是上周末拍的：Beck 当时正因为想加这个场景而去看，才第一次遇见 Clare；Clare 心里感激但没说自己已在这间屋里哭了三年。随后两人走上墙、走到天花板，Clare 说像做梦/像鬼，Beck 说“It’s the room that’s the ghost. The light you’re seeing is already six days old.”
quote: “Last weekend. I’d been thinking about adding it, that’s why I was there, when I first saw you. ... “It’s the room that’s the ghost. The light you’re seeing is already six days old.”
anchor: “When did you film this?” I am not sure how I feel

fact: 转折点：走出画廊时 Clare 感到“the outside world”回来了，悲伤仍在但开始能向前看、想象 Henry 死后的生活；随后 Isadora 突然说“You make my heart sing”，Beck 问是不是意识，答案是“No. But something less random than usual.”
quote: I feel the weight of my sadness shift—it still hangs over me, but I can begin to look forward and imagine my life after Henry’s death. ... “No. But something less random than usual. I need to figure out what.”
anchor: That’s what was missing, all that time I spent here

quote: When I get home, Alba is making Toll House cookies with Kimy. ... “It’s about time,” Kimy replies. “Here, Alba, let’s wash these dishes.”
